description: Oracle Database metrics — CDB · non-CDB · ASM · RAC
title: Oracle Exporter

targets.expr: max by (inst_id, instance_name, version, status) (oracle_instance_uptime_seconds{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id"})
sum by (inst_id) (oracle_session_count{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb", status="active"})
max by (instance, collector) (oracle_scrape_collector_success{instance="$instance"})
max by (instance, collector) (oracle_scrape_collector_duration_seconds{instance="$instance"})
max by (instance, inst_id, instance_name, version, status, is_cdb) (last_over_time(oracle_instance_info{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id"}[25h]))
max by (instance, pdb, open_mode, restricted) (last_over_time(oracle_pdb_info{instance="$instance"}[25h]))
max by (instance, patch_id, description, status, action, action_time) (last_over_time(oracle_sqlpatch_info{instance="$instance"}[25h]))

sort_desc(label_join(max by (instance, pdb, tablespace, contents, status) (oracle_tablespace_used_bytes{instance="$instance",pdb=~"$pdb"}) / max by (instance, pdb, tablespace, contents, status) (oracle_tablespace_total_bytes{instance="$instance",pdb=~"$pdb"}) * 100, "ts_label", ":", "pdb", "tablespace"))

sort_desc(
  max by (instance, diskgroup, type, state) (oracle_asm_diskgroup_used_bytes{instance="$instance"})
  / max by (instance, diskgroup, type, state) (oracle_asm_diskgroup_total_bytes{instance="$instance"})
  * 100
)
max by (instance, diskgroup, type, state) (oracle_asm_diskgroup_offline_disks{instance="$instance"})
sum by (inst_id, pdb, status, type) (oracle_session_count{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb"})
sum by (inst_id, pdb, type) (oracle_session_count{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb"})
sum by (inst_id, pdb, name) (rate(oracle_sysstat_value_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb", name="physical reads"}[10m]))
sum by (inst_id, pdb, name) (rate(oracle_sysstat_value_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb", name="physical writes"}[10m]))
sum by (inst_id, pdb, name) (rate(oracle_sysstat_value_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb", name="user commits"}[10m]))
sum by (inst_id, pdb, name) (rate(oracle_sysstat_value_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb", name="user rollbacks"}[10m]))
sum by (inst_id, pdb, name) (rate(oracle_sysstat_value_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb", name="execute count"}[10m]))
sum by (inst_id, pdb, name) (rate(oracle_sysstat_value_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb", name=~"parse count.*hard"}[10m]))
sum by (inst_id, pdb, wait_class) (rate(oracle_wait_class_time_waited_centiseconds_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb"}[10m])) / 100
sum by (inst_id, pdb, name) (rate(oracle_time_model_microseconds_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb"}[10m])) / 1e6
topk(10, sum by (inst_id, pdb, event, wait_class) (rate(oracle_event_time_waited_centiseconds_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb"}[10m])) / 100)
topk(10, sum by (inst_id, pdb, event, wait_class) (rate(oracle_event_waits_total{instance="$instance", inst_id=~"$inst_id", pdb=~"$pdb"}[10m])))
max by (instance) (oracle_fra_used_bytes{instance="$instance"})
max by (instance) (oracle_fra_reclaimable_bytes{instance="$instance"})
max by (instance) (oracle_fra_limit_bytes{instance="$instance"})
max by (instance) (oracle_fra_used_bytes{instance="$instance"}) / max by (instance) (oracle_fra_limit_bytes{instance="$instance"}) * 100
max by (instance) (oracle_fra_limit_bytes{instance="$instance"})
max by (instance) (oracle_fra_reclaimable_bytes{instance="$instance"})
max by (instance, name) (oracle_dataguard_lag_seconds{instance="$instance", name="transport lag"})
max by (instance, name) (oracle_dataguard_lag_seconds{instance="$instance", name="apply lag"})
max by (instance, pdb, tablespace, file_name) (oracle_datafile_over_maxsize{instance="$instance", pdb=~"$pdb"})
